evidence.excerpt: Our empirical evaluation on a widely used benchmark demonstrates that NEUROTESTGEN significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art approach across multiple LLMs, including Llama 3.3 70B1, GPT-4o Mini, Claude 3.5 Haiku3, and Claude Sonnet 4.6.
